R19 Bionic / all five modes on Snapdragon 8 Elite:
Native AA (preset 0): GSR2 1280x720->1280x720, WITHOUT reduced proxies; do not disable user-selected AA.
Quality (1): raster 854x480 -> output 1280x720.
Balanced (2): raster 752x424 -> output 1280x720.
Performance (3): raster 640x360 -> output 1280x720.
Ultra Performance (4): raster 426x240 -> output 1280x720; remove silent preset-3 clamping.
Real scale requires current-frame reduced raster writes to both color and depth. If absent, log GSR2_SCALE_PROOF and leave guest presentation unmodified; do NOT apply an upscaling filter to full-resolution content.
Shared native GPU: restore depth aspect conversion ordering, reacquire movable SlotVector references in depth/stencil, invalidate CPU texture hashes, hash entire page-size resource.
Regression: compile the actual five SceneResolution C++ output dimensions.
